docs/maintainers/inventions-and-world-ev.content: The original four recipe families—sling, bow, arrow and gathering tool—now have the PW03 woven-container, NP03 manufactured-cordage and AV02 shield families alongside them. The [finite family limits](../limits/inventions.md#rf01--world-owned-recipe-families) retain their supported scope; AV02 does not close the general family contract. The [playable-week designs](../projects/parallel-batch-01-playable-week-tech-design.md#pw02--family-definitions-not-engine-recipe-switches) and [PW02 work](parallel-batch-01-playable-week.md#pw02--world-owned-invention-families-and-one-admission-path) own the delivered world-family admission boundary and remaining integration qualification. PW03 supplies native compilation/crafting for both container sizes, PostgreSQL teaching/custody/restart and scripted ordinary Craft evidence; NP03 supplies the exact manufactured-binding dependency and consumption proof below. [PG01’s live player journey](../verification/camp-life.md#live-player-journey--october-4-2026) additionally qualifies player-directed generation, cord-to-container composition, ordinary use and reopen. Voluntary NPC chain choice and the shared ground-cache picker remain separately owned and unqualified. These results do not complete general host registration, arbitrary recursive composition or live-law migration; existing parent and release gates retain those distinct requirements.
